result.markdown: --- gd-head-tags: - >- ``{=html} open-graph: title: >- [CodelistEntry]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-dataclass} | Pointblank description: A single permitted value in a codelist. twitter-card: title: >- [CodelistEntry]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-dataclass} | Pointblank description: A single permitted value in a codelist. title: >- [CodelistEntry]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-dataclass} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 bread-crumbs: false toc-depth: 3 description-meta: A single permitted value in a codelist. page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} A single permitted value in a codelist. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/pointblank/blob/main/pointblank/metadata/_types.py#L21-L90){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-class} ```pythonsignature CodelistEntry( value, label, description=None, synonyms=None, is_deprecated=False, is_extended=False, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} A [`Codelist`](`pointblank.Codelist`) is a list of `CodelistEntry` objects, each pairing a coded value (the value that appears in the data, such as `"F"`) with a label that says what it means (such as `"Female"`). Codelist entries are created when [`import_metadata()`](`pointblank.import_metadata`) reads a codelist, and can also be created directly to build a codelist by hand. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [value]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Any]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The coded value, as it appears in the data. [label]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A human-readable label for the value. [description]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : A longer description of the entry. The default is `None`. [synonyms]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[str] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Other terms with the same meaning, such as the synonyms listed in CDISC Controlled Terminology. The default is `None`. [is_deprecated]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Whether the entry has been retired. A deprecated entry stays in the codelist (and in [`to_dict()`](`pointblank.Codelist.to_dict`)) but is left out of the permitted values given by [`to_set()`](`pointblank.Codelist.to_set`). The readers don't currently set this flag, but you can for codelists you build yourself. The default is `False`. [is_extended]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Whether the entry is a sponsor extension to an extensible codelist: a value that isn't in the published terminology but was added for a study. Define-XML marks these with `def:ExtendedValue="Yes"`. The default is `False`. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Each codelist imported from a file holds its entries in `codes`. Here are the entries of the `Sex` codelist in the bundled CDISC Controlled Terminology file: ::: {#cf5e551a .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pointblank as pb ct = pb.import_metadata(pb.load_metadata_example("sdtm_ct.xml"), codelist="Sex") sex = ct.get_codelist("Sex") for entry in sex.codes: print(entry.value, "->", entry.label) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` F -> Female M -> Male U -> Unknown UNDIFFERENTIATED -> Undifferentiated ``` ::: ::: The values are the codes used in the data, and the labels say what they mean. An entry can also be created directly, for example to build a codelist that isn't in any file: ::: {#017196da .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} entry = pb.CodelistEntry(value="NASOGASTRIC TUBE", label="Nasogastric tube", is_extended=True) entry ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` CodelistEntry(value='NASOGASTRIC TUBE', label='Nasogastric tube', description=None, synonyms=None, is_deprecated=False, is_extended=True) ``` ::: ::: Setting `is_extended=True` records that this value was added to an extensible codelist rather than taken from the published terminology, so [`extended_values()`](`pointblank.Codelist.extended_values`) will list it. ## See Also {.doc-see-also} [](`~Codelist`) : The list of entries that a codelist is made of.
